actualForegroundEvidence.positiveCases: Actual1/2/3-node foreground workflows plus delayed image flush, prepare-through-delivery serial gap and resource waiting exercise genuine root/orchestrator/provider/SDK flow. The remote model endpoint is an offline fake; registered synthetic PNG tool bodies and storage are real.
actualForegroundEvidence.identityAndSnapshots: Per-call immutable typed snapshots read back with actual historySha256,admissionId/run/node/attempt/controller identity; repeated textual call IDs remain distinct across nodes. Each child continuation receives paired tool replies followed by its own image; child histories stay out of parent transcript.
actualForegroundEvidence.serialTicket: Actual sibling cannot prepare/dispatch while prior ACC call and delivery own the session ticket; delayed image publication waits at actual guard rather than failing or borrowing another admission.
actualForegroundEvidence.resourceWait: Live run API remains waiting_resource despite actual tool heartbeat/gen activity, until genuine resource acquisition/call completion. This scenario intentionally writes its isolated fixture file; it is not a claim that all local writes were zero. No user-file or desktop input mutation occurred.
actualForegroundEvidence.negativeAdmission: Actual background and authenticated API-origin turn0 business ACC calls refuse without ledger rows or invented parent turn. Contextless read-only receipt control can return incomplete/lifecycle_unknown without creating a business action; malformed ID returns typed unknown.
actualForegroundEvidence.stopAndFaults: Stop after acknowledged node image preserves snapshot and dispatches no later node local mutation or model continuation. Intent EIO dispatches no business call; history EIO has actual SDK terminal but no delivery; lost reservation refuses before SDK send. Unknowns block child+parent continuation and remain held on restart.
actualForegroundEvidence.restartBoundary: Actual restart reopens valid per-call snapshot deliveries; deletion of one acknowledged snapshot is detected and held without new model request/replay. This does not resume or reconstruct complete child transcript/final assistant state.
